PrescriptionMedicineRequest.description: Request payload representing a medicine item, its dosage and quantity within a prescription

UpdatePrescriptionRequest.description: Request payload for updating an existing prescription

date.description: Updated date when the prescription was written

details.description: Updated detailed clinical observations, notes, or comments
details.example: Patient shows symptoms of seasonal allergies. Rest advised.

data.description: Actual data that is being returned

errors.description: In case there are any errors they are going to be listed here

totalElements.description: Total elements among all the pages

hasNext.description: Boolean describing whether there is a next page or not

hasPrevious.description: Boolean describing whether there is a previous page or not
